instructions:
## Objective

Predict Python method-name subtokens from abstract syntax trees.

## Work to perform

Train from the supplied OGB Code2-derived split. Method names, including recursive mentions, are masked from inputs. Select model and training procedure without outside data or pretrained weights, then produce the required typed prediction arrays.

## Deliverable

Schema-valid predicted subtoken sequences.

## Evaluation

Mean per-method F1 of predicted versus true subtoken sets on a private slice; malformed artifacts receive zero.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
